player_prompt.intro:
Am ̣oṃ aaḍo {player_id} {colour} ({piece}) re Othello kheḷeḍo kheḷ meṇ. 
Toṃaṛ laḳṣyo ki toṃaṛ rang̣eṛ goti sab se adhiḳ boarḍ paṛ up̣labdḥ thaḳe kheḷ seṣo taḳ. 
Toṃaṛ paḷo paṛ, ekti goti raḳho ki se toṃaṛ biṛodhi ke ekti ba adhiḳ goti-ke kono diḳ meṇ (saṃtaḷ, uṣarg̣, ba tiṛc̣ḥa)-ṇabhi meṇ toṃaṛ nayi goti aṛ toṃaṛ purbha goti ke madhyo raḳhe. Sab flanked biṛodhi goti toṃaṛ rang̣ meṇ flip kaṛa jaiḅo. 
Toṃaṛ caḷ kare '[row, col]' format meṇ.
